items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...when he had a chance of going with John Hammond or Joe Glazer, he went with Joe Glazer... [INTERVIEWEE] No, sir. ... I didn't know anything about John when I met him then...

ctx.x: Is it true that journalists out there thought he was Mr. Basie?
Thought who, Joe was. [Think] They couldn't be positive. (Inaudible) You heard that --
What can I tell you? Let's see, what was the most moving thing that somebody told you? What was the most moving thing that one of the guys said, do you remember? Anything that brought you back?
